notes: WordPress site with Jetpack (i0.wp.com) image proxy; originals fetched directly from /wp-content/uploads/. Many gallery originals are only ~1000 px wide (the site's own gallery size); the home-page slider images are 2000 px. Rooms & Rates page lists historic hotel rooms, cabins, cabin suites, Solar Suites, and camping, with property maps. The site has a /photo-credits/ page, so individual photographers may be credited there. The site notes a 'current conditions' page (fire/smoke/road), worth checking before any booking.
